subject.title: fix: Windows /restart falls back to in-process restart without changing PID

question: Should an env-less manually started Windows gateway use an installed Scheduled Task for `/restart`, and should the linked schtasks-probe PR be the canonical contract?
rationale: The reported fix path changes restart fallback behavior that current code intentionally treats as compatibility and availability sensitive, so automation should not choose the permanent Windows restart contract alone.

options.title: Review the schtasks-probe PR
options.body: Treat the linked PR as the canonical candidate, require exact task-name handling and redacted Windows PID or uptime proof, then land if the contract is accepted.

options.title: Keep in-process fallback
options.body: Preserve the current no-marker Windows behavior and document that a manually started gateway must restart through the Scheduled Task or reinstall/repair path.

options.title: Design a different handoff
options.body: Pause the linked PR and choose a different supervised handoff or doctor-repair contract for env-less Windows gateways.

recommendation.title: Review the schtasks-probe PR
recommendation.body: Treat the linked PR as the canonical candidate, require exact task-name handling and redacted Windows PID or uptime proof, then land if the contract is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Windows restart probe work plus adjacent supervisor-marker history makes this the best available routing signal for the contract decision.
